set.approach: From the campground at Twin Lakes, follow the main trail past the Hulk turn-off to Blarney Lake, where the buttress is easy to spot. Continue to Peeler Lake, staying right at the Crown Lake junction, then cut left around the west shore and pick a way up talus slopes to the base of the buttress. Slog up the talus to a good ledge that gives access to the big cleft or chimney and the buttress to its right. Nimue begins in the smallest of the left-facing corners, the third one counting from the right, set just beyond the point where the cleft reaches the ledge.
set.descent_text: From the top of the formation, follow the exposed easy ridge to the summit, then descend to the left to a third-class gully on the west side of the formation.
